## Data sources {#sec-data}

We pool vocabulary assessments of children with Down syndrome from several international studies, harmonised onto the common 800-item reference inventory described under [Measures](#measures). Each study contributes parent-report checklist counts of words *understood* and *spoken* — and, for the signing sub-set, words *signed* — together with the child's age in months. The table below inventories each study: the number of observations and distinct children, the age range, and the mean, median and quartiles of each measure (full detail in the accompanying CSV). The figures that follow plot the raw observations, one colour per study.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-ds-datasets
#| echo: false
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

_p = Path("figures/descriptives/dataset_summary_ds.csv")
_ds_summary = (
    pd.read_csv(_p)
    if _p.exists()
    else pd.DataFrame({"note": ["Run scripts/generate_descriptive_report.py"]})
)
_ds_summary
```
